metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature, observed with MODIS Aqua, in Arizona higher on July 15-21, 2017 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Aqua Land Surface Temperature (MODIS/006/MYD11A1) - Date 1: July 15-21, 2017 - Date 2: July 15-21, averaged over 2001-2010 (10 years) - Location: Arizona state boundary - Band: LST_Day_1km (daytime temperature, in Kelvin, needs scaling by 0.02) 2. Masking strategy: - Use QC band to mask poor quality pixels - The question is about actual temperature, so mask clouds/bad data 3. Logic: - Valid result: Compare 2017 mean temp vs 2001-2010 mean temp - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If after masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: If temperature values are None/NaN or unrealistic (e.g., <200K or >400K) - A: If 2017 > 2001-2010 average - B: If 2017 <= 2001-2010 average ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Arizona boundary const arizona = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Arizona')) .geometry(); // 2. Load MODIS Aqua LST collection const modisLST = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD11A1') .select('LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'); // Quality masking function function maskQuality(image) { const qc = image.select('QC_Day'); const mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // Good quality (bits 0-1 = 00) return image.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(mask).multiply(0.02); // Scale to Kelvin } // 3. Get 2017 data (July 15-21) const col2017 = modisLST .filterDate('2017-07-15', '2017-07-22') .filterBounds(arizona) .map(maskQuality); const size2017 = col2017.size().getInfo(); console.log('2017 Images found:', size2017); if (size2017 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2017 period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get 2001-2010 average (July 15-21 each year) const years = ee.List.sequence(2001, 2010); const historicalImages = years.map(function(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 7, 15); const endDate = startDate.advance(7, 'day'); const yearCol = modisLST .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(arizona) .map(maskQuality); return yearCol.mean().set('year', year); }); const colHistorical = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(historicalImages); const sizeHistorical = colHistorical.size().getInfo(); console.log('Historical period images:', sizeHistorical); if (sizeHistorical === 0) { console.log('No data for historical period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate means const img2017 = col2017.mean(); const imgHistorical = colHistorical.mean(); // Check pixel counts const count2017 = img2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: arizona, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const countHistorical = imgHistorical.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: arizona, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log('2017 valid pixels:', count2017); console.log('Historical valid pixels:', countHistorical); if (count2017 === 0 || countHistorical === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Calculate mean temperatures const temp2017 = img2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: arizona, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const tempHistorical = imgHistorical.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: arizona, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log('2017 mean temp (K):', temp2017 ? temp2017.toFixed(2) : 'null'); console.log('2001-2010 mean temp (K):', tempHistorical ? tempHistorical.toFixed(2) : 'null'); // 7. Validation and answer if (temp2017 === null || tempHistorical === null || temp2017 < 200 || temp2017 > 400 || tempHistorical < 200 || tempHistorical > 400) { console.log('Invalid temperature values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const tempDiff = temp2017 - tempHistorical; console.log('Temperature difference (K):', tempDiff.toFixed(2)); if (temp2017 > tempHistorical) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
